generation.scope: The exact inverse of the three-commutator map on every fixed ordered traceless target with smooth determinant is four symmetric 3x3 adjugate equations. Each admits two, zero or a smooth affine quadric of solutions; at most one of the four can degenerate because the four square-root Veronese surfaces contain the same elliptic normal sextic of rank-one multipliers. Thus the full ordered fibers are eight points, six points, or six isolated points plus a two-dimensional quadric, all realized. In particular the dominant map sl3^3 to sl3^3 has generic degree eight.

open_mathematics: Determine the monodromy of the four auxiliary roots along the complementary-plane elliptic quintic and the rational conic. Use this to separate the fixed-metric exceptional components and transfer all-degree regularity where possible. Extend the reconstruction beyond smooth cubic determinants.
